description.value:
At 11th level, the monk becomes so accustomed to movement that the very act of it invigorates him.

For every 5 feet of distance the monk travels, he gains +2 temporary hit points. This effect stacks with itself, allowing the monk to receive up to his monk level in temporary hit points from this ability.

At 17th level, the monk instead gains +3 temporary hit points for every 5 feet traveled.
